title: Deal Jacket / Vehicle Sale
description: The paper (and electronic) folder for one truck sale, from the first quote through F&I products to the finalized, funded deal.
x-sap-analogue: Sales order + billing document (VBAK/VBRK) with a separate financing/insurance line-item set
x-api-note: FI Sales History/Bulk/Delta is a documented read-only extract of already-finalized deals; there is no public Fortellis write API for desking/menu-selling/washout screens.
x-confidence-legend: Every property carries x-confidence: documented | inferred | unverified, copied from docs/model/model.json field-level confidence -- never uniform across an entity.

deal_status_code_c_b_p_f_i_u.description: FI Sales records carry a status code — C, B, P, F, I, or U — marking the deal's stage from pending through finalized
deal_status_code_c_b_p_f_i_u.x-cdk-field-name: Deal status code (C, B, P, F, I, U)
deal_status_code_c_b_p_f_i_u.x-source-title: BettrData — Fortellis CDK Drive API integration guide

we_owe_pending_deals_we_owes.description: A distinct tracked object for dealer obligations — accessories, service, cash-back — promised on the deal but not yet fulfilled
we_owe_pending_deals_we_owes.x-source-title: CDK Partner Program Pricing Guide PDF

finalized_booked_status.description: Marks the deal as balanced (all debits/credits net to zero) and closed — called 'Finalized' or 'Booked' in CDK/3PA language

customerid_deal_buyer.description: Link to the customer record associated with this deal, shared across Deals and Repair Orders
customerid_deal_buyer.x-source-title: Microsoft Learn — CDK Drive Customer connector

vin_sales_vehicles_reference.description: Link to the specific vehicle unit on this deal, from the partner-era 'Sales Vehicles' extract
vin_sales_vehicles_reference.x-source-title: CDK Partner Program Pricing Guide PDF

front_end_gross_selling_price_minus_vehi.description: Selling price minus vehicle cost, pack, and reconditioning — recognized at delivery, not at contract signing
front_end_gross_selling_price_minus_vehi.x-cdk-field-name: Front-end gross (selling price minus vehicle cost/pack/recon)

back_end_gross_f_i_commissions_reserve_a.description: F&I product commissions, finance reserve, and aftermarket income booked against a chargeback/EPO reserve
back_end_gross_f_i_commissions_reserve_a.x-cdk-field-name: Back-end gross (F&I commissions, reserve, aftermarket income)

payment_settling_reference_paynow_invite.description: Ties the deal to the payment-settling workflow that collects funds back into the DMS
